card.title: Better at the System
card.instruction: Treat every rule, shortcut, and correction as a chance to prove you understand the system better than anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My parking permit took six minutes at the expedited counter. Still filling yours in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You must have found my counter. Did you mention the renewal exemption?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used the website. It applied that automatically.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't learned where they hide the appeal button. I'll show you before you need it.

mechanism: A turns permit speed, exemption and website correction into successive opportunities to display superior system knowledge.
confusable: Unlike simply providing useful guidance, A must compare mastery and find a new advantage whenever B matches or exceeds it.
comparison: The permit alternative shifts from speed to exemptions to appeals. S178-b remains protected context only and is not reassessed or revised.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
